$description: Product brand-hue system channels. A THEME owns lightness and chroma; a PRODUCT owns hue via --brand-hue. Brand tokens compose as oklch(L C var(--brand-hue, <theme hue>)). Not theme-overridable, not component channels.

sail.compositionLaw: theme owns L/C; product owns hue. Every brand token reads oklch(L C var(--brand-hue, <theme's own hue>)). With no product set the theme looks as authored; with one set only the hue moves.
